description: Asks the user to authorize a scoped spend cap so the agent can execute write tools (transfers, swaps) WITHOUT a per-tx approval URL — within the grant's envelope. Returns an approval URL. After the user approves, transfers and swaps that fit inside the cap auto-execute and return the tx hash immediately.

allowed_selectors.description: Optional allowlist of 4-byte function selectors (e.g. '0xa9059cbb' for ERC-20 transfer).

allowed_targets.description: Optional allowlist of recipient/contract addresses. If unset, the grant covers any target.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

spend_cap_mon.description: Maximum total MON the agent can spend under this grant, as a decimal string e.g. "1.5".

ttl_seconds.description: How long this grant stays active, in seconds. Max 30 days.

name: grant_session_key
title: Grant a session-key spend cap
